name: Warm Up
intel: Standard approach. The mid-zone has restricted build space — plan your coverage first.

name: Repair Drones
intel: Repair Drone: heals nearby allies over time. Kill it before it restores tank HP.

name: Healing Column
intel: Two Healers embedded in the column. Sniper can pick them off over the mid-funnel zone.

name: Speed Heal
intel: Runners open the wave. Healers follow protected by speed — Sniper priority on healers.

name: Fast Lane Finale
intel: Healers, tanks, Shieldbearer, runners all at once. Kill supports first, then burst tanks.
